column1: # REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R4_B.tsv -- P05-S4 R4-4 pre-registration (appendix B to v4).  Written BEFORE any run of the R4-4 plan points.
# This file does NOT change REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R4.tsv (v4, hash-locked).  Any later correction is a new *_R4_ERRATA file.
# Purpose: the 22 R3 points that were INVALID (hit 0) with the old plan injector (R3 ERRATA_3 f), re-run with the new
#   injector inject_r4_plan.cpp, in which the call index K and the malloc index M are two independent counters.
# Request form: plancall:K:M with M = 1 (the first wrapped malloc inside plan call K), K = the R3 plan NTH of the point.
# Expectations: copied from the R3 pre-registration (REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R3.tsv, sha256 fc0c060b44200ee57059c3a0db8c5dae2af11efc6d2e02618731959e7841e428),
#   where B = CRASH and F = REPORTED_FAILURE for every plan point.  They were not changed.
#   Basis for the registration of these 22 points: R3 observed hit 0 for every one of them (RESULTS_R3.tsv, INVALID),
#   so the R3 expectation was never tested.  R4 tests it with the new counters.
# Expected class rule (fixed here): B = CRASH, F = REPORTED_FAILURE.  The result is judged by judge_d003.classify on facts.
# inj_call: 1 for once-route points, 2 for twice-route points (from FIELDCALL_MAP.tsv of R3, read by column name).
# UNREACHABLE_EXPECTED: a point whose plan call K has fewer than M = 1 wrapped malloc would give hit 0 (NOT_INJECTABLE).
#   Not expected a priori for M = 1 (every plan call makes at least one malloc, to be confirmed by the run or by gdb).
# status: INFLUENCED for every row (the R3 result was read before this file was written).
